# Origin

This package is vendored from `Telegram-iOS/Telegram/WatchApp/Packages/RLottieKit`
at Telegram-iOS commit `6ad963e5b62d354da79040f388ae2b9132fb17b8`.

BetterTG adds iOS to the package platforms and bounds decompressed TGS payloads
to 8 MiB. The renderer and its fixtures/tests otherwise remain Telegram's.
